description: Monthly Railroad Operational Summaries is a dataset listed in data.transportation.gov (U.S. DOT open data portal), an open data portal of the U.S. Department of Transportation under the section "Railroads", published or maintained by Railroads. All Railroads covered by Part 225 Accident/Injury reporting are required to provide monthly summary statistics via the form F6180.55. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Railroads". It has 12 columns, among them Month, RAILROAD, Report Date, PASSMI, TOTMI, EMPHRS. The portal shows 2020-10-07 as the last data update. Attribution given: Railroads. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-usdot-data-transportation-gov-portal.
